scriptName: 10/20 MA Coil: Progressive Colors & Multi-Day Breakout
source:
//@version=5
indicator("10/20 MA Coil: Progressive Colors & Multi-Day Breakout", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500)

// === User Inputs ===
maType = input.string("EMA", "MA Type", options=["SMA", "EMA"])
coil_tolerance = input.float(0.3, "Coil Tolerance (%)", minval=0.01)
bigMove_mult = input.float(1.5, "Big Move Size Multiplier", minval=0.5)
min_coil_streak = input.int(2, "Min Coil Days Before Breakout", minval=1)
showMAs = input.bool(true, "Show MA lines")
debug_plots = input.bool(false, "Show Debug Plots")

// === Moving Averages ===
ma(src, len) => maType == "SMA" ? ta.sma(src, len) : ta.ema(src, len)
ma10 = ma(close, 10)
ma20 = ma(close, 20)
ma50 = ma(close, 50)
plot(showMAs ? ma10 : na, color=color.green, linewidth=1)
plot(showMAs ? ma20 : na, color=color.orange, linewidth=1)
plot(showMAs ? ma50 : na, color=color.blue, linewidth=1)

// === ADR Calculation ===
adr = ta.sma(high - low, 20)

// === Coil Logic
dist = 100 * math.abs(ma10 - ma20) / ma20
ma50_up = ma50 > ma50[1]
price_close_above_MAs = close > ma10 and close > ma20
within_adr_above_MAs = (close - ma10 < adr * 1.5) and (close - ma20 < adr * 1.5)
coiled = dist < coil_tolerance and ma50_up and price_close_above_MAs and within_adr_above_MAs

// === Coil Streak
var int coil_streak = 0
coil_streak := coiled ? coil_streak + 1 : 0

// === Coil Color Gradient
get_coil_color(streak) =>
    color res = na
    if streak == 1
        res := color.new(color.orange, 85)
    else if streak == 2
        res := color.new(color.orange, 75)
    else if streak == 3
        res := color.new(color.orange, 65)
    else if streak == 4
        res := color.new(color.orange, 50)
    else if streak == 5
        res := color.new(color.orange, 35)
    else if streak == 6
        res := color.new(color.orange, 20)
    else if streak == 7
        res := color.new(color.orange, 5)
    else if streak > 7
        res := color.orange
    res
coil_color = get_coil_color(coil_streak)

// === Breakout Logic
was_coiled = coiled[1]
is_green = close > open
is_red = close < open
moved_up_atr = (close - open) >= adr
moved_down_atr = (open - close) >= adr
bull_breakout = was_coiled and is_green and moved_up_atr
bear_breakout = was_coiled and is_red and moved_down_atr

// === Candle Coloring
main_color = coiled ? coil_color : bull_breakout ? color.lime : bear_breakout ? color.black : na
use_custom = coiled or bull_breakout or bear_breakout
wick_col = close >= open ? color.green : color.red
border_col = wick_col
body_col = main_color

// === Candle Plot
barcolor(use_custom ? body_col : na)
plotcandle(open=use_custom ? open : na, high=use_custom ? high : na, low=use_custom ? low : na, close=use_custom ? close : na, color=body_col, wickcolor=wick_col, bordercolor=border_col, title="Coil/Breakout Candle")

// === Alerts
alertcondition(bull_breakout, "Bullish Breakout After Coil", "Bullish breakout from coil on {{ticker}} at {{interval}}")
alertcondition(bear_breakout, "Bearish Breakdown After Coil", "Bearish breakdown from coil on {{ticker}} at {{interval}}")

// === Debug (optional)
plot(debug_plots ? coil_streak : na, title="Coil Streak", color=color.gray)
plot(debug_plots ? (close - open) : na, title="Body Size", color=color.red)
plot(debug_plots ? adr : na, title="ADR", color=color.teal)
plot(debug_plots ? (close - ma10) : na, title="Dist to MA10", color=color.orange)
plot(debug_plots ? (close - ma20) : na, title="Dist to MA20", color=color.blue)
plotshape(debug_plots and bull_breakout ? high : na, title="Bull Breakout", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.green, text="BO")
plotshape(debug_plots and bear_breakout ? low : na, title="Bear Breakout", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.red, text="BD")
